title: Credit terms
intro: Credit terms are for approved companies only. They are not open yet.

p: A company can buy on credit after MECHWARE finance approves it. Approval criteria: [to be confirmed].
Payment terms are net 15 or net 30 days. MECHWARE finance sets the credit limit for each company.
An order on credit is allowed only if the credit already used plus the new order total stays within the limit.
Late payment charges and consequences: [to be confirmed].
